input_stub_file.description: Path to the old-style MZ executable to be used as the loader stub.

input_payload_file.description: Path to the NE/PE executable payload to be combined with the stub.

output_fat_file.description: Path for the output fat binary file combining the stub and payload.

keep_on_error.description: Keeps the output if an error is encountered, instead of deleting it. Corresponds to the -k option.

use_ep_cp_cblp.description: Derives the stub size from .e_cp and .e_cblp, rather than from .e_lfanew. Corresponds to the -p option.
